products.name: CareFlow Analytics
products.description: AI-powered clinical decision support and population health analytics
products.users: 18 hospital systems (subset of CareFlow Platform customers)
products.deployment: Separate AWS account, dedicated ML pipeline

contractual: BAA with all covered entity customers

current_framework_alignment.notes: Loosely aligned, no formal gap assessment performed against CSF 2.0. Controls mapped informally to HIPAA via NIST SP 800-66.

recent_audit_findings: SOC 2 Type II (2025): 2 exceptions noted - incomplete access review evidence, missing encryption-at-rest for one legacy database
HITRUST r2 (2025): Corrective Action Plan for 4 controls related to vulnerability management timelines
Penetration Test (2025): 2 medium findings (SSRF in internal API, weak session timeout)
known_gaps_self_reported: No formal risk register or risk treatment plan
Incident response plan not tested beyond tabletop
Third-party vendor security reviews are inconsistent
AI governance for CareFlow Analytics is informal
DLP not fully deployed across all data channels
BCP/DR tested annually but RTO/RPO not validated
